subject: Architecture
title: Biophilic Design: Nature Inside Architecture
description: A quick, practical guide to Biophilic Design: Nature Inside Architecture.

hook.text: Humans spend 90% of their time indoors, yet our brains are wired to crave nature.

buildup.text: Biophilic design brings nature into buildings — living walls, water features, natural light, and wood.

discovery.text: Studies show biophilic offices increase productivity by 15% and reduce sick days by 10%.

twist.text: Amazon's Spheres in Seattle house 40,000 plants inside glass domes — an office that's also a rainforest.

climax.text: Hospitals using biophilic design report patients healing faster and needing less pain medication.

punchline.text: Plants in the office aren't decoration. They're medicine.

quiz.question: What measurable effect does biophilic design have on office workers?
options: It doubles the number of job applicants
